messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: pattern across recent postmortems -> token validation errors after rolling deploys + missing audit writes for service-account rotations. Need concrete owners and short deadlines.

Alex Kim: Can we capture a sample failure log to bake into a smoke test?

Maya Chen: Sample we've seen:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: exp check failed, iss mismatch, request_id=abcd-1234
```

Jordan Patel: Also saw envoy cache-miss spikes ~20-40s post-deploy. Likely JWK/key-cache timing.

Sasha R.: Audit gap: two rotations completed with no `service-account:rotate` audit events. Rotation flow must confirm durable write before commit.

Leo Ortiz: Short plan:
1) Post-deploy token smokecheck (validate signed token end-to-end).
2) Rotation change: write+confirm to secure-log with retries.
3) Orphaned-creds sweep + runbook.
4) Authz trend dashboard + weekly anomaly alert.
Who owns each?

Maya Chen: Proposed owners/dates:
- Alex Kim: token smoke + CI gate (due 2026-04-01)
- Sasha R.: audit-write reliability & tests (due 2026-04-08)
- Jordan Patel: runbook + sweep automation (due 2026-04-15)
- Leo Ortiz: dashboard + alerts (due 2026-03-29)
I'll add to the remediation tracker after ack.

Alex Kim: ack. I'll add a tiny smoke script to infra/ci and open a PR, linking PM 758.

Sasha R.: ack. I'll add sync write+confirm step and retries; include unit and integration tests. ETA ~1 week.

Jordan Patel: I'll draft runbook "Detecting/remediating orphaned creds" and propose a k8s cron job sweep. RFC by Friday.

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5720 assigned to Alex Kim, due 2026-04-01

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5721 assigned to Sasha R., due 2026-04-08

Maya Chen: Suggest monthly 30-min "authz retro" to review trends and unblock owners.

Leo Ortiz: I'll host the dashboard & first retro.

Alex Kim: I'll attend.

Jordan Patel: In.

Sasha R.: In.

Maya Chen: I'll schedule the recurring and post playbook link: https://redwood.internal/docs/authz-triage-playbook

Maya Chen: Quick operational note: if you can't meet your deadline, flag here 48h before so we can reassign or reduce scope. Thanks :pray:
